MAR.note: A national framework for trusted, responsible AI is only planned, with its legal form unspecified; no draft or rule is stated.
The AI uses named are tax, customs and social-aid plans or sector systems, and the social-aid chatbot is only due in 2027; nothing in service or piloted in administration.

facts.fact: TelQuel, reading the PLF 2027 presentation note, says the tax directorate (DGI) had already begun designing an AI tool for automated fraud detection in 2026.

TelQuel says the PLF 2027 announces national AI models GemMaroc (language) and IsMa (speech transcription) for darija, amazigh and Arabic, to be developed with the R&D lab launched in January with Mistral AI.
TelQuel says a protocol with Nexus Core Systems Morocco for a sovereign AI Factory (high-performance computing data centre, centre of excellence, innovation hub) is listed in the 2026 record.

MAR.note: The 5000 AI trainers are not stated to be civil servants; no civil-service training stated.
A circular is only due to institute a Cloud First policy; no draft or adoption is stated.
Nothing on a national cyber body or strategy.
Data centres named are planned or under construction; none stated in service for hire.
Data protection is mentioned only as part of a planned AI framework; no law, decision or authority act stated.
Only school and university digital-skills aims and Code 212 centres; no national public programme with a count stated.

facts.fact: TelQuel says the PLF 2027 announces storage of Moroccans' data in a sovereign national cloud and a sovereign Jazari Root data centre for secure hosting of the state's strategic data, launching 2027-2029.

MAR.note: An AI assistant for social-aid questions is only due to be deployed in 2027; no channel in service or piloted.
No nationally owned data centre for hire in service is stated.
No local research institution contribution stated.
